title: Mathematical Foundations of Quantum Pricing Theory
summary: Let $M$ be a von Neumann algebra and let $(N_t)_{t\in[0,T]}$ be an increasing family of abelian von Neumann subalgebras encoding a (classical) information flow. Fix a faithful normal state $\varphi_ρ$ and a filtration of normal $\varphi_ρ$-preserving conditional expectations $E_t:M\to N_t$ satisfying the tower property.
